profile.role_note: Two modes: Tune Rupture (stack-and-detonate) and Fusion Burst.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: A premier Fusion hypercarry with one of the highest damage ceilings in 3.7 — strong pull if you need a Fusion DPS, with flexible Tune Rupture and Fusion Burst teams.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Everbright Polestar (or Emerald of Genesis) + 5-piece Trailblazing Star in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Sigillum in the main slot. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Fusion DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, and 120% Energy Regen so her Liberation is up every rotation.

ranked_weapons.name: Everbright Polestar
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. Crit Rate, All-Attribute DMG, and her Liberation ignores 64% DEF and 30% Fusion RES after Tune Rupture or Fusion Burst.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: Standard-banner sword; Crit Rate, ATK%, and Energy Regen. Strong and reliable alternative.

ranked_weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
ranked_weapons.note: High base stats and Crit; passive doesn't fit but the stat stick works.

ranked_weapons.name: Feather Edge
ranked_weapons.note: Best 4-star; Crit Rate, Liberation DMG, and ATK%.

ranked_weapons.name: Commando of Conviction
ranked_weapons.note: F2P-friendly ATK% sword with an Intro-triggered ATK buff.

echo_sets.name: Trailblazing Star
echo_sets.note: Tailor-made for her: 5-pc grants 20% Crit Rate and 20% Fusion DMG when she inflicts Tune Rupture or Fusion Burst, which she does every rotation.

echo_sets.name: Molten Rift
echo_sets.note: Older Fusion set; use while farming Trailblazing Star.

stat_priorities.note: Balance the Crit ratio; Crit Rate if the signature's substat doesn't cover it.
Fusion DMG on both by default; ATK% is fine as the second piece.

teams.name: Premium: Aemeath + Lynae + Mornye

members.name: Aemeath
members.note: Fusion hypercarry; set both her and Lynae to Tune Rupture Mode for max damage.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: All-DMG buffs plus Resonance Liberation amplification tailor-made for Aemeath's burst.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Off-Tune Buildup Rate and All-DMG amplification; accelerates the team's Tune Breaks.

teams.rotation: Mornye opens with her field-observation combo into Liberation, Outro to Lynae for her buff window, then Aemeath enters: Basics into Liberation, enhanced skill twice, and a held Heavy Attack into the second Liberation nuke.

teams.name: Budget: Aemeath + Verina + Sanhua

members.name: Aemeath
members.note: Her core damage comes from her own kit and Liberation scaling, so modest supports still work.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Free universal healer and buffer with coordinated attacks.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Fast rotations and Basic Attack DMG buffs from her Outro.

teams.rotation: Verina keeps the team alive and buffed, Sanhua quick-swaps in to drop her Basic Attack buff, then Aemeath takes a long on-field window. Expect longer kill times than the premium comp.

tier_badge.label: Meta-defining
tier_badge.note: Premier Fusion carry with one of the highest damage ceilings in 3.7.

sequences.verdict: S1 is the clear first jump; S3 is the best value stop for low-spenders, S6 only for whales.

pull_path.why: Full dual-mode kit; both Resonance Modes work at S0.
+300% CRIT DMG on charged Heavies; trail stacks carry on kills.
Finale +100% multiplier; Inherent Skill buff goes self-sufficient.
Fixed 80%/275% crit on Tune Rupture/Fusion Burst; doubled Trail stacks.

nodes.name: Gilded Glimmer of the First Dawn
nodes.effect: +300% CRIT DMG on charged Heavies in Instant Response; trail stacks carry to the next target on kill.

nodes.name: Downy Notes of Snowfluff
nodes.effect: Seraphic Duet Overture/Encore multipliers +100%; stronger Tune Rupture repeats and Fusion Burst detonations.

nodes.name: Fervor Sightly Burns Bright as New
nodes.effect: Finale multiplier +100%, Overdrive +40%; Inherent Skill grants 60% CRIT DMG self-sufficiently.

nodes.name: Ethereal Waltz on Binary Tides
nodes.effect: Intro or key skills grant the team 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 30s.

nodes.name: Voyage to the Astral Shore
nodes.effect: Starflux resets on kills; one cheat-death revive at full HP plus team shield every 10 min.

nodes.name: A Zephyr-Kissed Journey to You
nodes.effect: Targets take 40% more Liberation DMG; fixed 80%/275% crit on Tune Rupture/Fusion Burst; Trail stacks doubled, cap 60.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: S1 edges Everbright Polestar for main-DPS fluidity - grab S1 before the signature (gurugamer).
